releaseNotes:
Kerlyss 1.4.1-beta.1

New Features:
- Shuffle toggle in Up Next panel
- Beta update channel (Check for Beta Updates button)

Fixes:
- YouTube 403 fix - prefers muxed streams
- Premature completion detection for 403 errors
- Error reporting flow with sanitized logs
- Logger improvements (chained writes, debug logging)

Technical:
- Auto-skip after 4 broken songs
- Spotify import/updater crash triggers
- Rate-limited error prompts
- Removed betaChannel database field
